name: Immersion-app-akko
description: This is just an app for learning english and japanese

paragraphs: An immersion app for learning Japanese or American English, on your own computer. Free and open source.

You choose Japanese or English on the first visit, and can switch in Settings. Each language keeps its own words and progress. Lessons and the course are Markdown files you can edit or add to (see grammar/README.md and course/README.md).
features: Watch videos with subtitles. Search Japanese subtitles (kitsunekko, JP-Subtitles) or English ones (OpenSubtitles), load your own, or use the ones inside the video file (.mkv), no website needed.

Skip intro: a button over the video skips anime openings and endings (exact times from AniSkip, found from the show and episode), or mark a show's opening once with I and akko offers to skip it in its other episodes. K…
Send words to Anki as flashcards.
Study grammar with short lessons and quizzes (Japanese N5–N1, English A1–C1). Grammar you've studied is underlined in subtitles and texts.

whatItDoes.text: An immersion app for learning Japanese or American English, on your own computer. Free and open source.

requirements.text: Its server files (dictionaries, caches, OCR results, OpenSubtitles login) are in your user profile (%APPDATA%\akko\data on Windows), reachable from akko → Open the data folder.
If you use the app a lot, you can raise that limit with a personal access token (it doesn't need any permissions).
